text.brief: A county engineer on Kinmen reads the mainland's offer in 2030. Xiamen will add a power cable and a gas line beside the water pipe that has served the island since 2018, and the prices undercut anything Taipei can ship across the Strait.
text.record: Kinmen has drawn water from Fujian through an undersea pipeline since August 2018 ([Xinhua](https://english.news.cn/20250813/54bc89feaae2410e9e01eb2260ccea0e/c.html)). The island sits two miles off Xiamen and more than a hundred miles from Taiwan's main island. The Party has proposed a bridge from Xiamen to Kinmen as part of its plans for "integrated development" of Fujian and Taiwan.
text.reading: The Party builds the island's dependence one utility at a time. Each link brings real savings to residents, and each makes the island easier to squeeze. When pressure is needed, a maintenance outage on the pipe says more than a fleet. This is Stratagem 28, lure the enemy onto the roof and remove the ladder.
text.coreEvent: The mainland interrupts Kinmen's water supply for more than 72 hours by its own decision before 2035.
text.gapText: Technology Architecture. A front-line island buys its water from the power that claims it.
text.fix: Give Kinmen enough independent supply to walk away from any mainland utility for a year.
